we developed a computer-aided diagnostic method using texture analysis of (18)F-fluoride positron emission tomographic/computed tomographic images that can be applied to differential diagnosis of malignant and benign bone lesions.

the development of computer-aided detection (CAD) system to detect malignant lesions in PET/CT images, and the CAD system is based on the texture analysis of the PET images.
the development of a CAD method that utilizes the combined optimal PET and CT texture analysis to improve the differential diagnosis of malignant and benign bone/soft-tissue lesions.
the development of a CAD method that can differentiate malignant and benign soft tissue lesions on (18)FDG PET/CT images using texture analysis.

the present CAD method utilizing the optimal PET and CT texture analysis improved the differential diagnosis of malignant and benign bone lesions on (18) F-FDG PET/ CT images.

the texture analysis on (18)FDG PET/CT images can improve the diagnostic performance of malignant and benign lesions.
